items.q: So Harry taught me everything I knew, how to read and everything else.

ctx.x: Well you can learn drums from other musicians. I learned some drumming from Ben Canard, believe it or not. I really have. The great tenor sax player.
Yeah. They know too. So Harry taught me everything I knew, how to read and everything else.
Well, that's great, that's great, and that was about -- did you study with anyone else, drums, or music?
